name: fastsim_crv_response_prop
note: First CRV response-tuning study (fastsimkit task crv_response on UVA: one A100 job per point, the inputs streamed from the FNAL host through the kit host, which must be on the UVA network and reach the FNAL host by ssh): the light-propagation knobs of Offline PRs crv-fiber-speed / crv-fiber-atten in the fast chain, as ratios to the v6_0 lookup tables, per sector (EX speed and attenuation, T1 attenuation, T2 speed and attenuation). Each point replays the five V-R5 MDC2025as CrvStep files (112,304 events with CRV steps; fast chain matched to the full chain for these knobs, crv fiberprop_v1) with the out-of-time background model and the P4 module time calibration, and scores the size-free CRV response objective against run 125026 (crvreco-005-001). Objective: the mean of the 32 per-term distances, to minimise. T1 speed is not a knob: T1 is read out at one end, so its timing only fixes speed with an absolute time reference. Speed and attenuation are correlated through time walk, so they are tuned together.
